name: Comète
tagline: Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and shells side by side in one cockpit, with VS Code-grade terminals.
description: Comète runs your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or a plain shell) side by side, each in a real terminal, and shows at a glance which one is working, waiting or done. Task titles, notifications, skills and dictation are built in. The interface is in French.
